During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] carried out a '''mission''' to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]&mdash;also known as Moraband&mdash;as part of his journey to learn the secrets to [[Force ghost/Legends|manifesting his consciousness]] after [[Death/Legends|death]]. There, he encountered the spirit of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and a vision of [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]. He also encountered a vision created by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who attempted to destroy the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Yoda completed his trials and began training to learn the secrets from the spirit of Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
